flags.title: Committed injury transcription is materially incomplete against the official page
flags.detail: The committed hand transcription has 254 rows; the official nfl.com scrape captured at 2026-11-13T13:04:40+00:00 has 296. 55 players listed on the official page are absent from the transcription and 13 transcription players are absent from the official page. Among players present in both, 37 practice values, 3 injury names and 3 game statuses differ. This is a transcription-accuracy defect, not page drift: the scrape predates the transcription and already contains the values the transcription lacks.
